target_customer: Architects, developers and structural engineering firms that need a building structural design
problem: Structural engineers take four to six weeks to produce an initial structural solution and then iterate with the architect, which slows building design and wastes material.
business_model: B2B SaaS for structural design generation

founders.name: Martin Diz
education: Ph.D. Aerospace Engineering, University at Buffalo
founders.background_notes: YC page says he worked on embedded systems for drones and satellite control projects for NASA during his PhD.

founders.name: Juan Aleman
founders.background_notes: YC page describes two decades as a structural engineer specializing in seismic design.

technical_complexity.rationale: Generating validated structural designs in real time requires seismic modeling and optimization that draws on aerospace structural methods, per TechCrunch June 2020. The team was two founders and one employee.

defensibility.rationale: The edge was the founders' aerospace-derived optimization method, but engineering firms can switch tools and incumbents such as design software vendors could add similar features. No network or data lock-in was described.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying it. CB Insights lists Tekla among comparison pages, which is a database grouping and not evidence of a response.

market_need_then: TechCrunch June 2020 described long structural design cycles and material waste, with reported savings such as steel use cut 40 percent on a justice center in Mexico and about one million dollars saved on a COVID hospital in Ecuador, all company claims not independently verified.

brand_strength.rationale: Coverage was limited to TechCrunch, Forbes and regional Latin American press at launch. No community, merch or brand press was found. The name is spelled several ways (Tango Builder, TANGObuilder), which is mild confusion.

outcome_analysis: TANGObuilder joined YC Summer 2020 with a small seed and a clear time saving claim, but YC lists it inactive and no shutdown, acquisition or later round is public. Sources conflict on activity, since an undated CEMEX Ventures page cites over 160 projects and an undated job listing shows hiring. The cause of any wind down is not public, so failure factors stay empty.
notes: Company website is not listed on the YC page and the roster has an empty website field. Seed amount rests on CB Insights alone (2 rounds, 130K total); TechCrunch says a small seed with Tracy Young of PlanGrid participating, with no amount or date. Competitor search found no dated rivals near 2020 (Structure Plus, Finch, Generate surfaced with no dated source), so the list is empty. YC status Inactive conflicts with undated signs of activity.
